title: Anussutam
text: 1--2. Sāvatthi nidānam || || 3. Ayaṃ kāye kāyānupassanā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi [page 179] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 179 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Sā kho panāyam kāye kāyanupassanā bhāvetabbā ti me bhikkhave || bhavitā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 4. Ayam vedanānupassanā ti- || 5. Ayaṃ citte cittānupassanā ti. Ayaṃ dhammesu dhammānupassanā ti- || sā kho panāyaṃ dhammesu dhammānupassanā bhāvetabbā ti me bhikkhave || bhāvitā ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādīti || ||
